run_sampling_jax: run the sampling_jax script with a checkpoint, tokenizer, and input string to generate text
load_parameters: load model parameters from a RecurrentGemma checkpoint using single_device mode
create_sampler: create a Sampler instance with a Griffin model, SentencePiece vocab, and model params
build_griffin_config: build a GriffinConfig from Flax parameters with the RECURRENT_GEMMA_2B_V1 preset
sample_text: sample generated text from a Griffin model given an input string and max generation steps
